card.name: Linking words before causal attribution
card.fires_on: Small linking words or word endings that come just before a statement of cause or association, such as 'associated with', 'appears to be due', 'in some cases', or 'related to'. It appears in label safety text about lab changes or adverse events.

modes.label: Association phrases
modes.description: Words like with, related, due or equivalent that link an event to a cause or a comparison.
